main-window.description: Permissions for the main dashboard window. Grants the core set so the webview can listen for backend events (update-available, quota-updated, provider refresh) and query its own window state. Application commands are invoked directly and are not part of the ACL.

pet-window.description: Least-privilege permissions for the desktop pet window: listen for pet-window-settings events, drag the transparent window, and read its own position and monitor for clamping.

widget-window.description: Least-privilege permissions for the floating quota widget: listen for quota and widget-settings events, drag the frameless window by its drag region, and read its own position and monitor for clamping.
